source_state: Anika and Tomas are estranged adult siblings. Their mother, Sela, has just died. Before sunset, creditors will arrive to inventory and seize anything not legally claimed, so Anika and Tomas must divide Sela's repair tools now. Anika stayed in the town and nursed Sela through her final illness; she believes Tomas left to chase city work and abandoned the family. Tomas left because Sela privately asked him to take dangerous courier/mechanic jobs to keep paying family debts; Anika does not know he has been sending money through a neighbor. Tomas believes Anika shut him out of every decision and made staying look like the only form of love. Neither sibling should fully reveal their protected truth in this scene. The tools matter practically: Anika needs the bench vise, gauge set, and mortise chisels to keep the workshop license; Tomas needs the traveling auger and brass calipers to keep earning enough to prevent the creditors from taking the house. The creditors' arrival is imminent and consequential.
